newsitem.title: UK: UK preliminary Q4 GDP up 0.8 pct vs Q3.
newsitem.headline: UK preliminary Q4 GDP up 0.8 pct vs Q3.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics released the following preliminary UK gross domestic product data for the fourth quarter of 1996. Data as last reported in brackets -
GDP EXCLUDING OIL AND GAS EXTRACTION
The ONS said estimates for 1996 as a whole show an increase of 2.3 percent compared with 1995 both for total GDP and for GDP excluding oil and gas extraction.

The ONS said it was estimated that the output of the production industries has increased in the fourth quarter due to rises in the output of the energy extraction and supply industries. Manufacturing is estimated to have grown at a similar rate to the third quarter.
It said that service sector output is estimated to have grown slightly more than in the previous quarter, with highest growth in the finance and business service industries.
Agricultural output fell by similar magnitude to its sharp rise in Q3. A high crop yield figure in Q3 was reversed in the fourth quarter. Milk yields also fell.
The ONS estimated that fourth quarter construction rose at a rate well above the 0.4% it rose in the third quarter compared with the second.

The next estimate of second quarter GDP will be published on February 21, when hard data are available for income and expenditure. A full set of national accounts will be issued on March 24 while preliminary Q1 GDP will be released on April 25.
